Morning folks — quick midweek nudge on numbers so finance can lock the submission by EOD Friday. Please do the following by COB tomorrow (Wed):

- Update Stage field for any opportunity where the next committed step has changed (Close Date, Contract Sent, PO Received).
- Mark the commit signal (Green/Yellow/Red) in the attached latest_commit_matrix.csv and add one-line rationale.
- For any deals where legal/procurement is outstanding, add the expected gating item under "Blockers" in the sheet.

Two asks for this thread:
1) Can Marissa confirm the ACME numbers and surface any procurement timing risk?
2) Laura/Rishi please prepare 2–3 bullets per major deal for the 1 PM call tomorrow (see agenda attached).

Attachments: latest_commit_matrix.csv, call_agenda_v2.pdf

Thanks — I want the submission to be tidy going into the end-of-week review. If you hit any blocker that prevents a clean commit, flag it here so we can escalate.

- Acme Corp (ACME-2028-PR-47): We have verbal yes on the list price; finance asked for a short confirmation on the payment cadence (annual vs. quarterly) before we mark "Green". I added a note in the Blockers column. See acme-questionnaire.xlsx for their spreadsheet request.
- DeltaHealth: moved from Proposal to Contract Sent — legal expects counters by Thu. Marked Yellow (timing).
- Nova Retail: still early-stage, left as Commit=Red (no procurement date).

I'm attaching the Acme questionnaire they requested filled in where possible. I'll be on the 1 PM call tomorrow and will bring the Acme context.
